title: Probate Loans UK
summary: Silver Oak Capital's probate-lending page (search-result title 'Probate Loans UK') presents probate lending as a way to obtain funds during estate administration, often to cover inheritance tax. The product is described as a lender providing finance to the heirs, secured against their future inheritance, with inheritance tax bridging loans described as the most common type; the loan is repaid after the inheritance arrives. The page also states that probate is not always required, depending on the value and class of the assets. Related detail came from the firm's /faq/ page: loans can be arranged before or after a grant of probate (post-probate is more common and likely cheaper); lenders will generally fund Corporation Tax, VAT or Inheritance Tax bills payable before probate is granted if there is a clear exit strategy; some probate loans are FCA-regulated and others are not, and the firm offers to check a client's case before engaging a lender. No fees, rates, LTV, loan sizes, durations, timescales, eligibility criteria, process steps, testimonials or calls to action for this page were revealed by any search. Search (c) returned nothing about Silver Oak Capital at all.
